label: Smudged Lens Fix
blurb: Takes back the milky glow a greasy fingerprint, a smudged phone lens or a dirty filter spreads round every light: the haze round lamps, windows, screens and the sun, the lifted, washed out blacks near them and the long smear a wiped lens drags across the frame. It works out the glow that the bright parts of the picture would throw through that smudge, in real light, and takes it away again, so the lights keep their brightness and the dark parts next to them go back to dark. Streak length and direction match the smear of a lens wiped one way. It also takes out the soft bloom a game adds round bright things.
